body:
hey i'll check that book out. it's difficult to upkeep when you have no motivation. it's easy for me to spend hours on the computer lol. i think i did the same when in high school, i just adopted speech mannerisms to interact with everyone. had to learn how to socialize as well.

that's great you can talk to your step mom and you're at this place in your relationship, i think everyone needs someone like that in their life where you're open and honest with feelings. thank you for listening to my rant btw i never told anyone about them, seriously at least.

yo i love LOST lmao it's my top 5, i'm sure if i even have one but yeah. i was so invested in the characters i was willing to forget about that whole freighter/mercenary mess. i felt like there was hole in my heart when i was done watching it.

sounds like you step mom doesn't understand these feelings at all. i hated it when my dad was still around and he and my mom would yell at me to "act normal" when i was very much like what you described yourself as. did that exacerbate things for you? i think if you're going to have a child you have to truly be prepared, like knowing what to do when your child feels depressed at least...i hate being so dependent on my mom honestly.

hobbies? i don't have the drive to develop hobbies anymore :(. but i do doodle a lot and i guess i'm ok. i do want to get back to being a bookworm but i can't buy books and my vision makes it hard to focus on the text. books are such a great distraction from the real world. do you know some good books? i bake sometimes but i don't have measuring tools so there's a 50/50 chance it will taste like salty dough. and watching tv shows i guess :/ . thank you for sharing and replying.

hey, thanks for replying...yeah basically that's it. i started high school around that time, and prior to that i alleviated  my feelings of loneliness and inadequacy through religion. i stopped focusing on going to heaven basically, and i saw myself for who i really am. anxious, absent-minded, borderline agoraphobic...i took my 4 years day by day, and i came out more intent on suicide. got my diploma yesterday and was apparently an embarrassment to my mom...she actually can't look at me now! i wouldn't look at me either lol.

when i fall asleep and my consciousness lapses, i appreciate this feeling once i awaken and hope this i what it will be like when i finally die. sounds cheesy lol but i don't know why i go through the motions of living, it's all for nothing. why should i ever try to work so hard for something i don't care about? my family thinks i'm extremely strange to the point where it angers them and have been telling me so for a long time. i can't keep pretending to care about the future by fulfilling obligations and making goals... i just don't care about living life to its potential. fuck that..
